bool includes(string[] choices, string sought)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == sought
            return true
    return false

class Value(string kind, number := 0, text := "", left := 0, right := 0)
    string[] params := []
    rest := ""
    int[] body := []
    env_id := -1
    minimum := 0
    variadic := false
    builtin := false

class Frame(int parent)
    variables := map<string, int>()

class Engine()
    values := [Value("nil"), Value("void"), Value("uninitialized")]
    frames := [Frame(-1)]
    string[] lines := []
    nat row := 0
    nat column := 0
    output := ""
    midline := false

int store(Engine &engine, Value item)
    id := int(#engine.values)
    engine.values = engine.values.append(item)
    return id

int make_integer(Engine &engine, int number)
    return store(&engine, Value("integer", number))

int make_boolean(Engine &engine, bool flag)
    return store(&engine, Value("boolean", if flag then 1 else 0))

int make_pair(Engine &engine, int left, int right)
    return store(&engine, Value("pair", left = left, right = right))

int make_list(Engine &engine, int[] elements, tail := 0)
    result := tail
    for: #elements > index >= 0
        result = make_pair(&engine, elements[index], result)
    return result

int[] | none list_items(const Engine engine, int id)
    int[] result := []
    current := id
    while engine.values[current].kind == "pair"
        result = result.append(engine.values[current].left)
        current = engine.values[current].right
    return if current == 0 then result else none

bool truth(const Engine engine, int id)
    return engine.values[id].kind != "boolean" or engine.values[id].number != 0

string represent(const Engine engine, int id, quoted := true)
    item := engine.values[id]
    if item.kind == "integer"
        return string(item.number)
    if item.kind == "boolean"
        return if item.number == 0 then "#f" else "#t"
    if item.kind == "string"
        if not quoted
            return item.text
        string escaped := DQ
        for: index < #item.text
            character := item.text[index]
            escaped += if character == DQ then "\" + DQ elif character == "\" then "\\" elif character == NL then "\n" else character
        return escaped + DQ
    if item.kind == "symbol"
        return item.text
    if item.kind == "nil"
        return "()"
    if item.kind == "procedure"
        return if item.text == "" then "#<procedure>" else "#<procedure {item.text}>"
    if item.kind != "pair"
        return "#<void>"
    string[] pieces := []
    current := id
    while engine.values[current].kind == "pair"
        pieces = pieces.append(represent(engine, engine.values[current].left, quoted))
        current = engine.values[current].right
    if current != 0
        pieces = pieces.concat([".", represent(engine, current, quoted)])
    return "(" + pieces.join(" ") + ")"

bool same_value(const Engine engine, int first, int second, deep := false)
    left := engine.values[first]
    right := engine.values[second]
    if left.kind != right.kind
        return false
    if left.kind == "pair"
        return if deep then same_value(engine, left.left, right.left, true) and same_value(engine, left.right, right.right, true) else first == second
    if left.kind == "procedure"
        return first == second
    if left.kind == "integer" or left.kind == "boolean"
        return left.number == right.number
    if left.kind == "string" or left.kind == "symbol"
        return left.text == right.text
    return true

void | error shape(const Engine engine, bool valid, int form)
    if not valid
        return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, form))
    return void

int extend_frame(Engine &engine, int parent)
    id := int(#engine.frames)
    engine.frames = engine.frames.append(Frame(parent))
    return id

void bind(Engine &engine, int frame, string name, int id)
    .engine.frames[frame].variables.set(name, id)

int | error find_frame(const Engine engine, int frame, string name)
    current := frame
    while current >= 0
        match engine.frames[current].variables.get(name)
            int stored
                return current
            none
                current = engine.frames[current].parent
    return error("unbound variable: {name}")

int | error lookup(const Engine engine, int frame, string name)
    found := try find_frame(engine, frame, name)
    match engine.frames[found].variables.get(name)
        int stored
            if stored == 2
                return error("uninitialized variable: {name}")
            return stored
        none
            return error("unbound variable: {name}")

bool unique_names(string[] names)
    for: first < #names
        for: second < first
            if names[first] == names[second]
                return false
    return true

class Parameters(string[] names, string rest)

Parameters | none parse_parameters(const Engine engine, int id)
    string[] names := []
    current := id
    while engine.values[current].kind == "pair"
        element := engine.values[engine.values[current].left]
        if element.kind != "symbol"
            return none
        names = names.append(element.text)
        current = engine.values[current].right
    rest := ""
    if current != 0
        if engine.values[current].kind != "symbol"
            return none
        rest = engine.values[current].text
    if not unique_names(if rest == "" then names else names.append(rest))
        return none
    return Parameters(names, rest)

class Binding(string name, int expression)

Binding[] | none parse_bindings(const Engine engine, int id, bool unique)
    int[] entries
    match list_items(engine, id)
        int[] elements
            entries = elements
        none
            return none
    Binding[] result := []
    string[] names := []
    for entry := entries[]
        match list_items(engine, entry)
            int[] parts
                if #parts != 2 or engine.values[parts[0]].kind != "symbol"
                    return none
                name := engine.values[parts[0]].text
                names = names.append(name)
                result = result.append(Binding(name, parts[1]))
            none
                return none
    return if unique and not unique_names(names) then none else result

int make_closure(Engine &engine, Parameters formals, int[] expressions, int env_id, name := "")
    item := Value("procedure", text = name)
    item.params = formals.names
    item.rest = formals.rest
    item.minimum = int(#formals.names)
    item.variadic = formals.rest != ""
    item.body = expressions
    item.env_id = env_id
    return store(&engine, item)

int | error evaluate(Engine &engine, int expression, int env_id);
int | error invoke(Engine &engine, int procedure, int[] arguments);

int | error evaluate_body(Engine &engine, int[] expressions, int env_id)
    result := 1
    for expression := expressions[]
        result = try evaluate(&engine, expression, env_id)
    return result

int | error evaluate(Engine &engine, int expression, int env_id)
    item := engine.values[expression]
    if item.kind == "symbol"
        return lookup(engine, env_id, item.text)
    if item.kind != "pair"
        try shape(engine, expression != 0, expression)
        return expression
    int[] parts
    match list_items(engine, expression)
        int[] elements
            parts = elements
        none
            return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, expression))
    count := #parts
    keyword := if engine.values[parts[0]].kind == "symbol" then engine.values[parts[0]].text else ""
    if keyword == "quote"
        try shape(engine, count == 2, expression)
        return parts[1]
    if keyword == "if"
        try shape(engine, count == 3 or count == 4, expression)
        condition := try evaluate(&engine, parts[1], env_id)
        if truth(engine, condition)
            return evaluate(&engine, parts[2], env_id)
        return if count == 4 then evaluate(&engine, parts[3], env_id) else 1
    if keyword == "begin"
        return evaluate_body(&engine, parts[1:], env_id)
    if keyword == "lambda"
        try shape(engine, count >= 3, expression)
        match parse_parameters(engine, parts[1])
            Parameters formals
                return make_closure(&engine, formals, parts[2:], env_id)
            none
                return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, expression))
    if keyword == "define"
        try shape(engine, count >= 3, expression)
        target := engine.values[parts[1]]
        if target.kind == "symbol"
            try shape(engine, count == 3, expression)
            result := try evaluate(&engine, parts[2], env_id)
            if engine.values[result].kind == "procedure" and not engine.values[result].builtin and engine.values[result].text == ""
                engine.values[result].text = target.text
            bind(&engine, env_id, target.text, result)
        else
            try shape(engine, target.kind == "pair" and engine.values[target.left].kind == "symbol", expression)
            match parse_parameters(engine, target.right)
                Parameters formals
                    name := engine.values[target.left].text
                    result := make_closure(&engine, formals, parts[2:], env_id, name)
                    bind(&engine, env_id, name, result)
                none
                    return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, expression))
        return 1
    if keyword == "set!"
        try shape(engine, count == 3 and engine.values[parts[1]].kind == "symbol", expression)
        name := engine.values[parts[1]].text
        result := try evaluate(&engine, parts[2], env_id)
        destination := try find_frame(engine, env_id, name)
        bind(&engine, destination, name, result)
        return 1
    if keyword == "let" or keyword == "let*" or keyword == "letrec"
        named := keyword == "let" and count > 1 and engine.values[parts[1]].kind == "symbol"
        nat at := if named then 2 else 1
        try shape(engine, count >= at + 2, expression)
        Binding[] bindings
        match parse_bindings(engine, parts[at], keyword != "let*")
            Binding[] entries
                bindings = entries
            none
                return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, expression))
        local_frame := extend_frame(&engine, env_id)
        if keyword == "let*"
            if #bindings > 0
                local_frame = env_id
            for binding := bindings[]
                result := try evaluate(&engine, binding.expression, local_frame)
                local_frame = extend_frame(&engine, local_frame)
                bind(&engine, local_frame, binding.name, result)
        elif keyword == "letrec"
            for binding := bindings[]
                bind(&engine, local_frame, binding.name, 2)
            for binding := bindings[]
                result := try evaluate(&engine, binding.expression, local_frame)
                bind(&engine, local_frame, binding.name, result)
        else
            int[] arguments := []
            string[] names := []
            for binding := bindings[]
                result := try evaluate(&engine, binding.expression, env_id)
                arguments = arguments.append(result)
                names = names.append(binding.name)
            if named
                name := engine.values[parts[1]].text
                procedure := make_closure(&engine, Parameters(names, ""), parts[3:], local_frame, name)
                bind(&engine, local_frame, name, procedure)
                return invoke(&engine, procedure, arguments)
            for: binding := bindings[index]
                bind(&engine, local_frame, binding.name, arguments[index])
        return evaluate_body(&engine, parts[at + 1:], local_frame)
    if keyword == "cond"
        int[][] clauses := []
        for: 1 <= index < count
            match list_items(engine, parts[index])
                int[] clause
                    try shape(engine, #clause > 0, expression)
                    if engine.values[clause[0]].kind == "symbol" and engine.values[clause[0]].text == "else"
                        try shape(engine, #clause >= 2 and index + 1 == count, expression)
                    clauses = clauses.append(clause)
                none
                    return error("bad syntax: " + represent(engine, expression))
        for clause := clauses[]
            if engine.values[clause[0]].kind == "symbol" and engine.values[clause[0]].text == "else"
                return evaluate_body(&engine, clause[1:], env_id)
            result := try evaluate(&engine, clause[0], env_id)
            if truth(engine, result)
                return if #clause == 1 then result else evaluate_body(&engine, clause[1:], env_id)
        return 1
    if keyword == "and" or keyword == "or"
        result := make_boolean(&engine, keyword == "and")
        for part := parts[1:][]
            result = try evaluate(&engine, part, env_id)
            if truth(engine, result) == (keyword == "or")
                return result
        return result
    if keyword == "when" or keyword == "unless"
        try shape(engine, count >= 3, expression)
        condition := try evaluate(&engine, parts[1], env_id)
        return if truth(engine, condition) == (keyword == "when") then evaluate_body(&engine, parts[2:], env_id) else 1
    procedure := try evaluate(&engine, parts[0], env_id)
    int[] arguments := []
    for part := parts[1:][]
        result := try evaluate(&engine, part, env_id)
        arguments = arguments.append(result)
    if engine.values[procedure].kind != "procedure"
        return error("not a procedure: " + represent(engine, procedure))
    return invoke(&engine, procedure, arguments)

void output_text(Engine &engine, string text)
    engine.output += text
    if text != ""
        engine.midline = text[#text - 1] != NL

void output_line(Engine &engine, string text)
    if engine.midline
        output_text(&engine, NL)
    output_text(&engine, text + NL)

int | error expect(const Engine engine, string name, int id, string kind)
    valid := engine.values[id].kind == kind
    if kind == "list"
        match list_items(engine, id)
            int[] elements
                valid = true
            none
                valid = false
    if not valid
        return error("{name}: expected {kind}, got " + represent(engine, id))
    return id

int[] | error checked_list(const Engine engine, string name, int id)
    checked := try expect(engine, name, id, "list")
    match list_items(engine, checked)
        int[] elements
            return elements
        none
            return error("invalid list")

int | error builtin(Engine &engine, string name, int[] arguments)
    if includes(["+", "*", "-", "quotient", "remainder", "modulo", "abs", "min", "max", "gcd", "=", "<", ">", "<=", ">="], name)
        int[] numbers := []
        for argument := arguments[]
            checked := try expect(engine, name, argument, "integer")
            numbers = numbers.append(engine.values[checked].number)
        result := if #numbers == 0 then 0 else numbers[0]
        if name == "+" or name == "*"
            result = if name == "+" then 0 else 1
            for number := numbers[]
                result = if name == "+" then result + number else result * number
        elif name == "-"
            if #numbers == 1
                result = -result
            else
                for number := numbers[1:][]
                    result -= number
        elif name == "abs"
            if result < 0
                result = -result
        elif name == "min" or name == "max"
            for number := numbers[]
                if (name == "min" and number < result) or (name == "max" and number > result)
                    result = number
        elif name == "gcd"
            result = 0
            for number := numbers[]
                divisor := if number < 0 then -number else number
                while divisor != 0
                    remainder := result % divisor
                    result = divisor
                    divisor = remainder
        elif name == "quotient" or name == "remainder" or name == "modulo"
            divisor := numbers[1]
            if divisor == 0
                return error("{name}: division by zero")
            quotient := result / divisor
            remainder := result - divisor * quotient
            result = if name == "quotient" then quotient else remainder
            if name == "modulo" and remainder != 0 and ((remainder < 0) != (divisor < 0))
                result += divisor
        else
            valid := true
            for: 1 <= index < #numbers
                left := numbers[index - 1]
                right := numbers[index]
                comparison := if name == "=" then left == right elif name == "<" then left < right elif name == ">" then left > right elif name == "<=" then left <= right else left >= right
                valid = valid and comparison
            return make_boolean(&engine, valid)
        return make_integer(&engine, result)
    if name == "not"
        return make_boolean(&engine, not truth(engine, arguments[0]))
    if name == "eq?" or name == "equal?"
        return make_boolean(&engine, same_value(engine, arguments[0], arguments[1], name == "equal?"))
    if includes(["null?", "pair?", "list?", "number?", "symbol?", "procedure?"], name)
        argument := arguments[0]
        valid := false
        if name == "list?"
            match list_items(engine, argument)
                int[] elements
                    valid = true
                none
                    valid = false
        else
            kind := if name == "null?" then "nil" elif name == "number?" then "integer" else name[:<#name - 1]
            valid = engine.values[argument].kind == kind
        return make_boolean(&engine, valid)
    if name == "cons"
        return make_pair(&engine, arguments[0], arguments[1])
    if name == "list"
        return make_list(&engine, arguments)
    if name == "car" or name == "cdr" or name == "cadr"
        checked := try expect(engine, name, arguments[0], "pair")
        if name == "car"
            return engine.values[checked].left
        if name == "cdr"
            return engine.values[checked].right
        second := try expect(engine, name, engine.values[checked].right, "pair")
        return engine.values[second].left
    if name == "length" or name == "reverse" or name == "list-ref"
        elements := try checked_list(engine, name, arguments[0])
        if name == "length"
            return make_integer(&engine, int(#elements))
        if name == "reverse"
            return make_list(&engine, elements[::-1])
        checked := try expect(engine, name, arguments[1], "integer")
        index := engine.values[checked].number
        if index < 0 or index >= int(#elements)
            return error("list-ref: index out of range: {index}")
        return elements[index]
    if name == "append"
        if #arguments == 0
            return 0
        int[] elements := []
        for argument := arguments[:<#arguments - 1][]
            part := try checked_list(engine, name, argument)
            elements = elements.concat(part)
        return make_list(&engine, elements, arguments[-1])
    if includes(["map", "filter", "fold-left", "apply"], name)
        procedure := try expect(engine, name, arguments[0], "procedure")
        if name == "apply"
            spread := try checked_list(engine, name, arguments[-1])
            return invoke(&engine, procedure, arguments[1:<#arguments - 1].concat(spread))
        nat first := if name == "fold-left" then 2 else 1
        int[][] lists := []
        nat length := 1000000
        for argument := arguments[first:][]
            elements := try checked_list(engine, name, argument)
            lists = lists.append(elements)
            if #elements < length
                length = #elements
        int[] result := []
        accumulator := arguments[1]
        for: index < length
            int[] actual := if name == "fold-left" then [accumulator] else []
            for elements := lists[]
                actual = actual.append(elements[index])
            called := try invoke(&engine, procedure, actual)
            if name == "filter"
                if truth(engine, called)
                    result = result.append(lists[0][index])
            elif name == "map"
                result = result.append(called)
            else
                accumulator = called
        return if name == "fold-left" then accumulator else make_list(&engine, result)
    if name == "string-append"
        result := ""
        for argument := arguments[]
            checked := try expect(engine, name, argument, "string")
            result += engine.values[checked].text
        return store(&engine, Value("string", text = result))
    if name == "number->string"
        checked := try expect(engine, name, arguments[0], "integer")
        return store(&engine, Value("string", text = represent(engine, checked)))
    if name == "display"
        output_text(&engine, represent(engine, arguments[0], false))
        return 1
    if name == "newline"
        output_text(&engine, NL)
        return 1
    checked := try expect(engine, name, arguments[0], "string")
    message := engine.values[checked].text
    for argument := arguments[1:][]
        message += " " + represent(engine, argument)
    return error(message)

int | error invoke(Engine &engine, int procedure, int[] arguments)
    item := engine.values[procedure]
    if int(#arguments) < item.minimum or (not item.variadic and int(#arguments) != item.minimum)
        expected := (if item.variadic then "at least " else "") + string(item.minimum)
        name := if item.text == "" then "lambda" else item.text
        return error("{name}: wrong number of arguments (expected {expected}, got {#arguments})")
    if item.builtin
        return builtin(&engine, item.text, arguments)
    env_id := extend_frame(&engine, item.env_id)
    for: name := item.params[index]
        bind(&engine, env_id, name, arguments[index])
    if item.rest != ""
        rest := make_list(&engine, arguments[item.minimum:])
        bind(&engine, env_id, item.rest, rest)
    return evaluate_body(&engine, item.body, env_id)

void skip_line(Engine &engine)
    engine.row += 1
    engine.column = 0

bool at_end(Engine &engine)
    while engine.row < #engine.lines
        line := engine.lines[engine.row]
        while engine.column < #line and line[engine.column] == " "
            engine.column += 1
        if engine.column < #line and line[engine.column] != ";"
            return false
        skip_line(&engine)
    return true

class Token(string kind, value := 0)

Token | error next_token(Engine &engine)
    if at_end(&engine)
        return error("unexpected end of input")
    line := engine.lines[engine.row]
    character := line[engine.column]
    engine.column += 1
    if includes(["(", ")", "'"], character)
        return Token(character)
    if character == DQ
        result := ""
        while engine.column < #line
            current := line[engine.column]
            engine.column += 1
            if current == DQ
                return Token("value", store(&engine, Value("string", text = result)))
            if current == "\"
                if engine.column == #line
                    break
                current = line[engine.column]
                engine.column += 1
                if current != DQ and current != "\" and current != "n"
                    return error("bad escape")
                if current == "n"
                    current = NL
            result += current
        return error("unterminated string")
    start := engine.column - 1
    while engine.column < #line and not includes([" ", "(", ")", "'", DQ, ";"], line[engine.column])
        engine.column += 1
    atom := line[start:<engine.column]
    if atom == "."
        return Token(".")
    nat digit_start := if atom[0] == "+" or atom[0] == "-" then 1 else 0
    integer := digit_start < #atom
    for: digit_start <= position < #atom
        integer = integer and "0123456789".contains(atom[position])
    if integer
        return Token("value", make_integer(&engine, int(atom)))
    if atom == "#t" or atom == "#f"
        return Token("value", make_boolean(&engine, atom == "#t"))
    if atom[0] == "#"
        return error("bad token: {atom}")
    return Token("value", store(&engine, Value("symbol", text = atom)))

int | error read_datum(Engine &engine);

int | error datum_from(Engine &engine, Token token)
    if token.kind == "value"
        return token.value
    if token.kind == "'"
        quoted := store(&engine, Value("symbol", text = "quote"))
        datum := try read_datum(&engine)
        return make_list(&engine, [quoted, datum])
    if token.kind != "("
        return error("unexpected {token.kind}")
    int[] elements := []
    while true
        next := try next_token(&engine)
        if next.kind == ")"
            return make_list(&engine, elements)
        if next.kind == "." and #elements > 0
            tail := try read_datum(&engine)
            closing := try next_token(&engine)
            if closing.kind != ")"
                return error("expected )")
            return make_list(&engine, elements, tail)
        datum := try datum_from(&engine, next)
        elements = elements.append(datum)

int | error read_datum(Engine &engine)
    next := try next_token(&engine)
    return datum_from(&engine, next)

interpreter := Engine()
builtin_names := "+ * - quotient remainder modulo abs min max gcd = < > <= >= not eq? equal? null? pair? list? number? symbol? procedure? cons car cdr cadr list length append reverse list-ref map filter fold-left apply string-append number->string display newline error".split(" ")
minimum := [0, 0, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1]
for: name := builtin_names[index]
    procedure := Value("procedure", text = name)
    procedure.minimum = minimum[index]
    procedure.variadic = includes(["+", "*", "-", "min", "max", "gcd", "=", "<", ">", "<=", ">=", "list", "append", "map", "fold-left", "apply", "string-append", "error"], name)
    procedure.builtin = true
    id := store(&interpreter, procedure)
    bind(&interpreter, 0, name, id)
while true
    string input
    scan(&input)
    if input == "(exit)"
        break
    interpreter.lines = interpreter.lines.append(input)
while not at_end(&interpreter)
    match read_datum(&interpreter)
        int expression
            match evaluate(&interpreter, expression, 0)
                int result
                    if result != 1
                        output_line(&interpreter, represent(interpreter, result))
                error failure
                    output_line(&interpreter, "Error: {failure.message}")
        error failure
            output_line(&interpreter, "Error: read: {failure.message}")
            if failure.message == "unexpected end of input"
                break
            skip_line(&interpreter)
if interpreter.midline
    output_text(&interpreter, NL)
print(interpreter.output)
